messages.subject: season as a covariate
parts:
Hi all,

I'm currently trying to run some models and one of the covariates I wanted to introduce is seasons, but I'm having doubts on how to do it and wanted to be sure I'm thinking straight. As each of my sessions is on a specific season if I put a column with the season as a covariate on each tdf it would be similar within each tdf and just vary between tdfs. Is this a problem? Should I implement this differently? Thank you in advance.

Best regards,

Gonçalo Delgado

messages.author: 527d9b3ec7deff2d
messages.subject: Re: season as a covariate
parts: Hi Gonçalo, sorry for the delay here.  If season is a covariate for detection, then yes a TDF indicator that is identical for all traps should work.  If you wanted it as a covariate for density, then each session's state space would need the indicator (where all grid cells have the same value within a session).

Hi Gonçalo, sorry for the delay here.  If season is a covariate for detection, then yes a TDF indicator that is identical for all traps should work.  If you wanted it as a covariate for density, then each session's state space would need the indicator (where all grid cells have the same value within a session).
